cases.sentence: Я истинная виноградная ___, а мой отец виноградарь.
cases.translation: I am the true vine, and my father is the gardener.
cases.explain: Лоза is the predicate noun describing the subject я, so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.translation: They hated me without any cause.
cases.explain: The preposition без ('without') always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Если вы послушны моим ___, то вы будете жить в моей любви.
cases.translation: If you are obedient to my commandments, you will live in my love.
cases.explain: The short-form adjective послушны ('obedient to') governs its complement in the dative case.

cases.sentence: Никто не может любить больше, чем тот, кто отдает жизнь свою за ___.
cases.translation: No one can love more than the one who lays down his life for his friends.
cases.explain: The preposition за ('for') governs the accusative here; for an animate plural noun the accusative form matches the genitive.

cases.sentence: Я больше не называю вас ___, потому что слуга не знает, что делает его хозяин.
cases.translation: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know what his master is doing.
cases.explain: The verb называть ('to call someone something') places the predicate noun in the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: В этом исполняется сказанное в их ___.
cases.translation: This is to fulfill what is written in their law.
cases.explain: The preposition в ('in') governs the prepositional case here, indicating location within the law.

reading.ru: Ветвь сама по себе плодов приносить не может, если не будет на лозе.
reading.question: What does Jesus say a branch cannot do by itself?
options: Bear fruit unless it remains in the vine
reading.correct: Bear fruit unless it remains in the vine
reading.explain: Jesus says a branch cannot bear fruit by itself unless it remains on the vine.

reading.ru: Кто не пребывает во мне, тот подобен ветке, что выброшена вон и засыхает.
reading.question: What happens to someone who does not remain in Jesus?
options: He is thrown out like a branch and withers
He is hidden from the world
reading.correct: He is thrown out like a branch and withers
reading.explain: Jesus compares one who does not remain in him to a branch that is thrown out and withers.

reading.ru: Вот моя заповедь, любите друг друга, как я вас полюбил.
reading.question: What is Jesus's commandment to his followers?
options: Love one another as he has loved them
reading.correct: Love one another as he has loved them
reading.explain: Jesus's commandment is that they love one another as he has loved them.

reading.ru: Я больше не называю вас слугами, потому что слуга не знает, что делает его хозяин, но я называю вас друзьями, потому что все, что я услышал от моего отца, я открыл вам.
reading.question: Why does Jesus call his disciples 'friends' instead of 'servants'?
options: Because he has made known to them everything he heard from his Father
Because they paid off a debt to him
Because they are older than he is
Because servants are punished more harshly
reading.correct: Because he has made known to them everything he heard from his Father
reading.explain: Jesus explains that he calls them friends because he revealed to them everything he heard from his Father.

reading.ru: Вы меня не выбирали, я сам вас выбрал и назначил, чтобы вы шли и приносили плод, и чтобы ваш плод выдержал испытания временем.
reading.question: According to Jesus, who chose whom?
options: Jesus chose the disciples, not the other way around
reading.correct: Jesus chose the disciples, not the other way around
reading.explain: Jesus says the disciples did not choose him; he chose and appointed them.

reading.ru: Если мир вас ненавидит, помните, что сначала он возненавидел Меня
reading.question: What does Jesus tell the disciples about the world's hatred?
options: The world hated him before it hated them
The world will never hate them
Only Judas will be hated by the world
reading.correct: The world hated him before it hated them
reading.explain: Jesus tells them to remember that the world hated him first, before it hated them.

reading.ru: Вы тоже будете свидетельствовать, потому что вы были со мной с самого начала.
reading.question: Why will the disciples also testify about Jesus?
options: Because they have been with him from the beginning
Because the Counselor forced them to
reading.correct: Because they have been with him from the beginning
reading.explain: Jesus says the disciples will testify because they have been with him from the beginning.
